body.statement: Construct \(\mathfrak A\) so that the unrestricted real parameter space of every \(\pi\in\mathfrak S_3\) is partitioned into finitely many semialgebraic strata on each of which the fiber of \(\widetilde\Phi_{\le3}\) has a certified constant cardinality and a certified set of chain orders. For every singleton-order stratum, provide an observable rational chart for \(u\) and \(v\); for every non-singleton or positive-dimensional stratum, provide explicit real parameter twins or a fiber parameterization. Determine on all intersections of rank-drop and denominator-zero hypersurfaces whether the failure of \(\operatorname{Rec}\) is removable or is genuine nonidentification.
body.justification: This exposes the genuine unresolved content instead of equating one failed rational denominator with structural ambiguity.
body.gap: Generic elimination in Tramontano et al. (2025) and Garcia-Puente et al. (2010) does not classify real fibers on exceptional intersections; Drton, Foygel, and Sullivant (2011) do not cover this higher-moment latent LiNGAM map.
body.consumer: A completed atlas yields exact ambiguity warnings and alternate formulas for observations near every failure divisor of the cubic branch.
